usage: sakura cockpit act [-h] [--text TEXT] [--model MODEL] [--role ROLE]
                          [--step STEP] [--name NAME] [--from FROM]
                          [--label LABEL] [--percent PERCENT] [--plan PLAN]
                          [--since SINCE] [--verdict VERDICT] [--note NOTE]
                          [--remember REMEMBER] [--choice CHOICE]
                          [--folder FOLDER] [--level LEVEL] [--preset PRESET]
                          [--rule RULE] [--value VALUE] [--accounts ACCOUNTS]
                          [--device DEVICE] [--port PORT]
                          [--provider PROVIDER] [--state STATE] [--op OP]
                          [--choices CHOICES] [--until UNTIL]
                          [--project PROJECT] [--title TITLE]
                          [--definition DEFINITION] [--track TRACK]
                          [--goal GOAL] [--summary SUMMARY] [--status STATUS]
                          [--clear CLEAR] [--decision DECISION]
                          [--answer ANSWER] [--task TASK]
                          [--conversation CONVERSATION] [--startop STARTOP]
                          [--on ON] [--kind KIND] [--address ADDRESS]
                          [--at AT] [--lookback_hours LOOKBACK_HOURS]
                          [--language LANGUAGE] [--account ACCOUNT]
                          [--revision REVISION] [--candidate CANDIDATE]
                          [--candidate_revision CANDIDATE_REVISION]
                          [--confirm TOKEN] [--actor LOGIN]
                          [--source {cli,app}] --json
                          key target

positional arguments:
  key                   action key from the snapshot's actions list, or add-
                        project
  target                the id of an item, group, account, wait or project of
                        the snapshot; for add-project, the folder to add

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --text TEXT           input text
  --model MODEL         input model
  --role ROLE           input role
  --step STEP           input step
  --name NAME           input name
  --from FROM           input from
  --label LABEL         input label
  --percent PERCENT     input percent
  --plan PLAN           input plan
  --since SINCE         input since
  --verdict VERDICT     input verdict
  --note NOTE           input note
  --remember REMEMBER   input remember
  --choice CHOICE       input choice
  --folder FOLDER       input folder
  --level LEVEL         input level
  --preset PRESET       input preset
  --rule RULE           input rule
  --value VALUE         input value
  --accounts ACCOUNTS   input accounts
  --device DEVICE       input device
  --port PORT           input port
  --provider PROVIDER   input provider
  --state STATE         input state
  --op OP               input op
  --choices CHOICES     input choices
  --until UNTIL         input until
  --project PROJECT     input project
  --title TITLE         input title
  --definition DEFINITION
                        input definition
  --track TRACK         input track
  --goal GOAL           input goal
  --summary SUMMARY     input summary
  --status STATUS       input status
  --clear CLEAR         input clear
  --decision DECISION   input decision
  --answer ANSWER       input answer
  --task TASK           input task
  --conversation CONVERSATION
                        input conversation
  --startop STARTOP     input startop
  --on ON               input on
  --kind KIND           input kind
  --address ADDRESS     input address
  --at AT               input at
  --lookback_hours LOOKBACK_HOURS
                        input lookback_hours
  --language LANGUAGE   input language
  --account ACCOUNT     input account
  --revision REVISION   input revision
  --candidate CANDIDATE
                        input candidate
  --candidate_revision CANDIDATE_REVISION
                        input candidate_revision
  --confirm TOKEN       the token a confirm result returned
  --actor LOGIN         login written to the action log and the ledger
  --source {cli,app}    where the person acts: a terminal (cli) or the Sakura
                        window (app)
  --json                print the result as JSON
